title: School Teachers Take Oath Of Loyalty

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 00078
Date

CHINA PRESS.
DEC 20 1938

Chinese Said
Giving Money
To Pay Debts

Great enthusiasm has been shown
by Shanghailanders in the move-
ment for $1 contributions to the
Government for the repayment of
the Chinese national debts, a Chin-
ese report said yesterday.
Led by General Hsieh Ching-
yuan, famed commander of the
Lone Battalion which for five days
defied Japanese heavy artillery fire
in a Chapei godown, a large num-
ber of local Chinese residents were
said to have made their contribu-
tions.
Some of the contributions, the
report said, were sent to local
Chinese newspapers which are act-
ing as agents of the Central Bank;
others were sent direct to the bank
office.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 00078
日期

《字林西报》。
1938年12月20日

华人称
捐款用于
偿还债务

据昨日一份中文报告称，上海外侨在响应向政府捐献一美元以偿还中国国债的运动中表现出极大的热情。
据悉，在曾在闸北一座仓库内率领“孤军”抵抗日军重炮火力达五日之久的著名指挥官谢晋元将军的带领下，大量本地华人居民已进行了捐款。
该报告称，部分捐款被送往担任中央银行代理人的本地中文报纸；其他捐款则直接寄往银行办事处。

page_data.en:
December 21, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News :-

SCHOOL TEACHERS TAKE OATH OF LOYALTY

To demonstrate their unity as well as loyalty
to the Party and the nation, teachers of various grades
of schools in this locality have promoted an "educational
employees' oath-making movement."

It is learned that since the promotion of
this movement in September this year up to yesterday,
many schools have joined the movement. The presidents
of the schools have filled the following form on behalf
of their respective teaching staff s-

"I swear will all sincerity that I will deal
with education absolutely in accordance with the aims
and purposes of education as promulgated by the
National Government; I will never register with the
puppet organization nor will I accept any appointments
or subsidies from it. Should I ever violate this
oath, I am willing to undergo the most severe
punishment from the people and the Government."
page_data.zh:
1938年12月21日。下午译文。

《中美日报》：

学校教师宣誓效忠

为展示其团结以及对党和国家的忠诚，本地各级学校的教师发起了一项“教育职员宣誓运动”。

据悉，自今年九月发起该运动以来至昨日，已有许多学校加入。各校校长代表其 respective 教职员工填写了以下表格——

“我诚心宣誓，我将完全按照国民政府颁布的教育宗旨和目的从事教育工作；我绝不向伪组织登记，也不接受其任何委任或津贴。若我违背此誓言，我愿接受人民和政府最严厉的惩罚。”

SHANGHAI MUNICIPALITY
No. S. A. D. 8952
Date 2 2 33

Standard and other local newspapers :- 22-12-38

THE DOLLAR LOAN REFUND MOVEMENT

In connection with the $1 Loan Refund Movement, the Shanghai Municipality Educational Circles' Thrift Movement Acceleration Committee yesterday issued the following open letter addressed to educational circles:
"China's position in the family of nations has been greatly elevated because of her prolonged resistance. Democratic nations are in sympathy with her and are rendering assistance. Through the efforts of our Finance Commission, America has agreed to extend to China credit for Gold $25,000,000, while Britain has also promised to approve a loan of £10,000,000. With these large credits, there will be great improvement in China's military and economic strength. In the meantime, we should do our utmost to show ourselves worthy of their sympathy and help.
"The American and British credits amount approximately to Chinese $460,000,000. These loans can be immediately repaid if each of us contribute $1. As this movement has now been voluntarily started, we should assist this movement. It should not prove a difficult task, for the only thing we have to do is to curtail unnecessary expenses..."

上海特别市
编号 S. A. D. 8952
日期 2 2 33

《标准晚报》及其他本地报纸：1938年12月22日

一美元贷款偿还运动

关于一美元贷款偿还运动，上海市教育界节约运动加速委员会昨日向教育界发出如下公开信：
“由于长期的抵抗，中国在国际大家庭中的地位已大大提高。民主国家对中国表示同情并提供援助。通过我们财政委员会的努力，美国已同意向中国提供2500万美元的黄金信贷，英国也承诺批准1000万英镑的贷款。有了这些巨额信贷，中国的军事和经济实力将大为改善。同时，我们应竭尽全力，证明自己值得他们的同情和帮助。
“美英信贷总额约合华币4.6亿元。如果我们每人捐献一美元，这些贷款即可立即偿还。鉴于此运动现已自愿发起，我们应予以协助。这不应是一项艰巨的任务，因为我们唯一需要做的就是削减不必要的开支……”
